bs.title: GymLeader — Rutine, trening i napredak na jednom mjestu
bs.description: Sačuvaj rutine, bilježi serije, kilaže i ponavljanja, prati težinu i mjere tijela. GymLeader povezuje trening, grafikone, dnevnik ishrane i Meal Planner.
hero: Manje pamćenja. Više fokusa na trening.
Sačuvaj trening koji želiš ponavljati, zabilježi kilaže i ponavljanja i vidi šta si radio prošli put. GymLeader drži tvoj trening na jednom mjestu.
Web aplikacija. Otvori je u svom pregledniku.
Tvoja rutina je spremna za sljedeći trening.
routine: Jedan plan. Trening koji možeš ponavljati.
Napravi, recimo, ‘Plan za noge’, dodaj svoje vježbe i pokreni ga kad želiš. Ne moraš praviti novu rutinu svake sedmice.
Jedan trening. Ponovi ga kada želiš.
features: Znaš šta radiš. Vidiš kako napreduješ.
Za ljude koji treniraju samostalno i žele urediti svoje rutine, umjesto da svaki put traže bilješke.
cards: Napravi vlastiti trening, dodaj vježbe i uredi plan kada ti zatreba. Sačuvana rutina spremna je za ponavljanje.
Bilježi vježbe, serije, kilaže, ponavljanja i bilješke. Pogledaj prethodne rezultate i lične rekorde, pa znaš odakle krećeš.
Vrati se završenim treninzima i pogledaj grafikone vježbi. Uporedi svoje rezultate kroz vrijeme, uz pregled aktivnosti u izabranom periodu.
Po želji bilježi tjelesnu težinu i obime tijela. Grafikoni mjerenja pomažu da vidiš promjene kroz vrijeme.
Dodaj hranu u dnevnik i prati kalorije i makronutrijente. Meal Planner predlaže obroke iz kataloga prema opcijama i ograničenjima, uz listu namirnica za kupovinu.
Postavi sedmični cilj trening dana i pogledaj aktivnost po danima. Niz sedmica s ostvarenim ciljem pokazuje kontinuitet, kada istorija daje dovoljno podataka.
bs.estimate: Nutritivne vrijednosti i cijene su procjene iz kataloga. Planer ne optimizuje plan prema preciznom kalorijskom cilju.
how: Počni jednim treningom koji želiš ponavljati. Ostalo dodaj svojim tempom.
steps: Sačuvaj rutinu.
Otvori aplikaciju, napravi nalog i dodaj vježbe u svoj plan. Nemaš rutinu? Pogledaj generator prijedloga i uredi plan prije spremanja.
Zabilježi trening.
Pokreni sačuvanu rutinu i unesi serije, kilaže i ponavljanja koje si odradio. Završi trening da ostane u istoriji.
Vrati se svom napretku.
Na sljedećem treningu ponovo otvori rutinu. Pregledaj prošle rezultate, istoriju i grafikone da vidiš kako se tvoji treninzi mijenjaju.
faqIntro: Imaš još neko pitanje? Piši nam. Tu smo i kada ti nešto u aplikaciji nije jasno.
faq: Šta je GymLeader i kome je namijenjen?
GymLeader je web aplikacija za organizovanje rutina, bilježenje treninga i praćenje napretka. Namijenjena je ljudima koji žele samostalno voditi pregled svojih treninga i ishrane.
Moram li praviti novi plan svake sedmice?
Ne. Jedan plan predstavlja jedan trening koji sačuvaš i možeš ponavljati kada želiš. Na primjer, ‘Plan za noge’ ostaje među tvojim rutinama dok ga ne promijeniš ili ukloniš.
Šta ako nemam vlastitu rutinu?
U aplikaciji možeš koristiti generator prijedloga plana. Pregledaj prijedlog i prilagodi ga prije spremanja. Ako su generatoru potrebni dodatni podaci, aplikacija će ih zatražiti.
Moram li preuzeti aplikaciju iz prodavnice?
GymLeader koristiš preko preglednika na telefonu ili računaru. Na podržanim uređajima možeš dodati prečicu na početni ekran. Za početak otvori gymleader.app.
Šta mogu pratiti tokom treninga?
Možeš bilježiti vježbe, serije, kilaže, ponavljanja i bilješke, pregledati završene treninge, lične rekorde i grafikone napretka. Praćenje tijela omogućava da po želji unosiš težinu i obime.
Koliko su precizni podaci o ishrani?
Kalorije, makronutrijenti i cijene u Meal Planneru su procjene iz kataloga. Provjeri porciju, sastojke i etikete, naročito ako imaš alergije. GymLeader ne zamjenjuje ljekara ili dijetetičara.
Kako se prijavljujem?
Na gymleader.app možeš napraviti nalog emailom i potvrditi ga verifikacionim kodom ili koristiti ponuđenu Google prijavu. Postojeći nalog otvaraš svojim izabranim načinom prijave.
contact: Imaš prijedlog, naišao si na problem ili ti nešto nije jasno? Ako je nešto komplikovano ili ti se ne sviđa, reci nam. Pomažeš nam da GymLeader bude bolji.
Klik otvara tvoju email aplikaciju. Ako se ne otvori, kopiraj adresu i pošalji nam poruku iz svog email servisa.
final: Tvoja rutina je početak. Napredak gradiš svaki put kad se vratiš.
legal: Za pitanja o ovim dokumentima piši na
Informacije o obradi podataka u GymLeader aplikaciji.
terms: GymLeader je aplikacija za pravljenje planova treninga, bilježenje vježbi, praćenje kilaža, ponavljanja, trajanja, napretka i ličnih rezultata.

GymLeader nije medicinska usluga i ne zamjenjuje doktora, fizioterapeuta ili kvalifikovanog trenera. Korisnik sam procjenjuje da li je određena vježba sigurna za njega. Ako imaš povredu, bolest ili nedoumicu, obrati se zdravstvenom stručnjaku.

Odgovoran/na si za tačnost podataka koje unosiš i za čuvanje pristupa svom nalogu. Nije dozvoljeno dijeljenje naloga radi zloupotrebe, neovlašten pristup tuđim podacima, pokušaj zaobilaženja sigurnosnih mjera, slanje zlonamjernog koda ili preopterećivanje aplikacije.

Trudimo se da GymLeader bude dostupan, siguran i pouzdan. Zbog problema s internetom, uređajem, serverom, održavanjem ili drugih tehničkih okolnosti može doći do prekida, kašnjenja ili gubitka podataka. Offline podaci čekaju sinhronizaciju; povremeno provjeri status sinhronizacije važnih treninga.
Možeš obrisati nalog kroz Podešavanja. Brisanje može trajno ukloniti profil, rutine, treninge i druge podatke, osim podataka koje smo dužni čuvati prema zakonu.
Naziv GymLeader, logo, dizajn, kod i sadržaj aplikacije zaštićeni su. Dobijaš ograničeno pravo korištenja aplikacije za lične ili odobrene poslovne potrebe.
Možemo mijenjati, poboljšavati ili privremeno obustaviti dijelove aplikacije. Kod važnih promjena prikazaćemo novu verziju ovih pravila.
privacy: GymLeader obrađuje podatke potrebne za rad aplikacije i korisničkog naloga: ime ili nadimak, pol, godine, visinu, težinu, cilj, učestalost treninga, mjesto treninga, iskustvo, ciljne mišićne grupe, vježbe koje želiš ili izbjegavaš, alergije i hranu koju moraš izbjegavati, email adresu, podatke za prijavu, rutine, istoriju treninga, kilaže, ponavljanja, trajanje, bilješke, mjerenja težine i obima tijela, jezik, podešavanja i tehničke podatke potrebne za sigurnost i sinhronizaciju.

Podatke koristimo za kreiranje i održavanje naloga, prijavu i potvrdu email adrese, čuvanje rutina i treninga, sinhronizaciju između uređaja, sigurnost sistema i pružanje podrške. Podatke ne prodajemo.

Za rad aplikacije koristimo pouzdane tehničke provajdere, uključujući Firebase, Vercel i Brevo, samo u obimu potrebnom za njihove funkcije. Ako kasnije aktiviraš plaćanje, Lemon Squeezy će obrađivati podatke potrebne za naplatu prema svojim pravilima.
Možeš zatražiti pristup, ispravku, brisanje ili izvoz svojih podataka kada je to zakonski primjenjivo. Zahtjeve možeš poslati na gymleaderapp@gmail.com.

Podatke čuvamo onoliko dugo koliko je potrebno za rad naloga, sigurnost sistema ili zakonske obaveze. Koristimo razumne tehničke mjere zaštite, ali nijedan online sistem ne može garantovati apsolutnu sigurnost ili neprekidan rad.
Ovu politiku možemo ažurirati. Kada promjena zahtijeva novu potvrdu, prikazaćemo novu verziju prije nastavka korištenja aplikacije.
bs.preference: Javni sajt pamti samo jezički izbor u lokalnoj pohrani preglednika i, na HTTPS GymLeader domenama, u cookieju gymleader-language koji važi i za aplikaciju. Sadrži samo jezički kod, traje do godinu dana i služi da se tvoj posljednji izbor prenese između sajta i aplikacije. Ovaj sajt ne dodaje analitičko praćenje.

en.title: GymLeader — Workout routines, tracking and progress
en.description: Save workout routines, log sets, weights and reps, and track body weight and measurements. Explore GymLeader workout charts, food diary and Meal Planner.
hero: Less to remember. More focus on training.
Save a workout you want to repeat, record your weights and reps, and see what you did last time. GymLeader keeps your training in one place.
A web app. Open it in your browser.
Your routine is ready for your next workout.
routine: One plan. A workout you can repeat.
Create a ‘Leg day’ plan, add your exercises and start it whenever you want. You don’t need a new routine every week.
One workout. Repeat it whenever you want.
features: Know what you’re doing. See your progress.
For people who train independently and want organised routines instead of hunting for notes every time.
cards: Create your own workout, add exercises and edit your plan when needed. Your saved routine is ready to repeat.
Log exercises, sets, weights, reps and notes. Check previous results and personal records so you know where to start.
Revisit completed workouts and explore exercise charts. Compare results over time and review activity for your selected period.
Optionally record body weight and circumference measurements. Measurement charts help you see changes over time.
Add food to your diary and track calories and macros. Meal Planner suggests catalogue meals based on your options and restrictions, with an ingredient shopping list.
Set a weekly goal for workout days and see activity by day. A streak of weeks meeting your goal shows consistency when your history provides enough data.
en.estimate: Nutrition values and prices are catalogue estimates. The planner does not optimise meals to a precise calorie target.
how: Start with one workout you want to repeat. Add the rest at your own pace.
steps: Save a routine.
Open the app, create an account and add exercises to your plan. No routine yet? Review a generated suggestion and edit it before saving.
Log your workout.
Start your saved routine and enter the sets, weights and reps you completed. Finish the workout to keep it in your history.
Return to your progress.
Open the routine again for your next workout. Review previous results, history and charts to see how your training changes.
faqIntro: Have another question? Write to us. We’re here when something in the app isn’t clear, too.
faq: What is GymLeader and who is it for?
GymLeader is a web app for organising routines, logging workouts and tracking progress. It is for people who want to manage their own training and nutrition records.
Do I need a new plan every week?
No. One plan is one saved workout that you can repeat whenever you want. For example, ‘Leg day’ stays in your routines until you change or remove it.
What if I don’t have a routine?
You can use the app’s plan suggestion generator. Review and adjust the suggestion before saving. The app asks for additional information if the generator needs it.
Do I need to download an app from a store?
Use GymLeader in a browser on your phone or computer. On supported devices you can add a shortcut to your home screen. To start, open gymleader.app.
What can I track during training?
You can log exercises, sets, weights, reps and notes, then review completed workouts, personal records and progress charts. Body tracking lets you optionally record weight and circumferences.
How accurate is the nutrition information?
Calories, macros and prices in Meal Planner are catalogue estimates. Check portions, ingredients and labels, especially if you have allergies. GymLeader does not replace a doctor or dietitian.
How do I sign in?
At gymleader.app you can create an account by email and confirm it with a verification code, or use the available Google sign-in. Access an existing account using your chosen sign-in method.
contact: Have a suggestion, found a problem or unsure about something? Tell us if something feels complicated or you don’t like it. You help us make GymLeader better.
This opens your email app. If nothing opens, copy the address and send a message using your email service.
final: Your routine is the beginning. Build progress each time you return.
legal: For questions about these documents, email
Terms of use for the GymLeader application.
How the GymLeader application processes data.
terms: GymLeader is an application for creating workout plans, logging exercises and tracking weights, repetitions, duration, progress and personal results.

GymLeader is not a medical service and does not replace a doctor, physiotherapist or qualified trainer. Users must assess whether an exercise is safe for them. If you have an injury, illness or concerns, consult a healthcare professional.

You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you enter and for protecting access to your account. Sharing accounts for abuse, accessing other users’ data without permission, attempting to bypass security measures, sending malicious code or overloading the application is prohibited.

We aim to keep GymLeader available, secure and reliable. Internet, device, server, maintenance or other technical issues may cause interruptions, delays or data loss. Offline data awaits synchronisation; occasionally check the sync status of important workouts.
You can delete your account in Settings. Deletion may permanently remove your profile, routines, workouts and other data, except information we are required to retain by law.
The GymLeader name, logo, design, code and application content are protected. You receive a limited right to use the application for personal or approved business purposes.
We may change, improve or temporarily suspend parts of the application. We will display a new version of these terms for important changes.
privacy: GymLeader processes information needed for the application and user account: name or nickname, gender, age, height, weight, goal, training frequency, training location, experience, target muscle groups, exercises you want or avoid, allergies and foods you must avoid, email address, sign-in information, routines, workout history, weights, repetitions, duration, notes, body weight and circumference measurements, language, settings and technical data needed for security and synchronisation.
We use data to create and maintain accounts, provide sign-in and email verification, save routines and workouts, synchronise devices, secure the system and provide support. We do not sell data.

We use reliable technical providers, including Firebase, Vercel and Brevo, only as needed for their functions. If you activate payments in the future, Lemon Squeezy will process billing data under its own policies.
You may request access to, correction, deletion or export of your data where applicable by law. Send requests to gymleaderapp@gmail.com.

We retain data for as long as needed to operate your account, maintain system security or meet legal obligations. We use reasonable technical safeguards, but no online system can guarantee absolute security or uninterrupted operation.
We may update this policy. Where a change requires renewed acceptance, we will display a new version before you continue using the application.
en.preference: The public site remembers only your language preference in browser storage and, on HTTPS GymLeader domains, in the gymleader-language cookie shared with the app. It contains only a language code, lasts up to one year and transfers your latest choice between the site and app. This site adds no analytics tracking.

de.title: GymLeader — Trainingspläne, Trainingstagebuch und Fortschritt
de.description: Speichere Trainingsroutinen, dokumentiere Sätze, Gewichte und Wiederholungen und verfolge Gewicht und Körpermaße. Mit Diagrammen, Ernährungstagebuch und Meal Planner.
hero: Weniger merken. Mehr Fokus aufs Training.
Speichere ein Training zum Wiederholen, notiere Gewichte und Wiederholungen und sieh nach, was du zuletzt geschafft hast. GymLeader bündelt dein Training an einem Ort.
Eine Web-App. Öffne sie im Browser.

routine: Ein Plan. Ein Training zum Wiederholen.
Erstelle zum Beispiel einen Plan ‘Beintag’, füge Übungen hinzu und starte ihn, wann du möchtest. Du brauchst nicht jede Woche eine neue Routine.

features: Wisse, was du trainierst. Sieh deinen Fortschritt.
Für Menschen, die selbstständig trainieren und ihre Routinen ordnen möchten, statt jedes Mal nach Notizen zu suchen.

how: Beginne mit einem Training, das du wiederholen möchtest. Ergänze den Rest in deinem Tempo.
steps: Speichere eine Routine.

Dokumentiere dein Training.
Starte deine gespeicherte Routine und trage absolvierte Sätze, Gewichte und Wiederholungen ein. Schließe das Training ab, damit es im Verlauf bleibt.
Sieh dir deinen Fortschritt an.
Öffne die Routine beim nächsten Training erneut. Vergleiche frühere Ergebnisse, Verlauf und Diagramme und sieh, wie sich dein Training entwickelt.
faqIntro: Noch eine Frage? Schreib uns. Auch wenn etwas in der App unklar ist, sind wir für dich da.
faq: Was ist GymLeader und für wen ist es gedacht?

GymLeader ist eine Web-App zum Organisieren von Routinen, Dokumentieren von Trainings und Verfolgen von Fortschritten. Sie richtet sich an Menschen, die Training und Ernährung selbst dokumentieren möchten.
Brauche ich jede Woche einen neuen Plan?
Nein. Ein Plan ist ein gespeichertes Training, das du jederzeit wiederholen kannst. Ein ‘Beintag’ bleibt zum Beispiel in deinen Routinen, bis du ihn änderst oder löschst.
Was mache ich ohne eigene Routine?
Nutze den Generator für Planvorschläge in der App. Prüfe den Vorschlag und passe ihn vor dem Speichern an. Falls weitere Angaben nötig sind, fragt die App danach.
Muss ich eine App aus einem Store herunterladen?
GymLeader läuft im Browser auf dem Smartphone oder Computer. Auf unterstützten Geräten kannst du eine Verknüpfung zum Startbildschirm hinzufügen. Öffne zum Start gymleader.app.
Was kann ich beim Training erfassen?
Du kannst Übungen, Sätze, Gewichte, Wiederholungen und Notizen erfassen sowie abgeschlossene Trainings, persönliche Rekorde und Fortschrittsdiagramme ansehen. Gewicht und Körperumfänge sind optional.
Wie genau sind die Ernährungsangaben?
Kalorien, Makronährstoffe und Preise im Meal Planner sind Katalogschätzungen. Prüfe Portionen, Zutaten und Etiketten, besonders bei Allergien. GymLeader ersetzt weder Arzt noch Ernährungsfachkraft.
Wie melde ich mich an?

Auf gymleader.app kannst du ein Konto per E-Mail erstellen und mit einem Bestätigungscode verifizieren oder die angebotene Google-Anmeldung nutzen. Melde dich mit der für dein Konto gewählten Methode an.
contact: Du hast einen Vorschlag, ein Problem entdeckt oder eine Frage? Sag uns, wenn etwas umständlich ist oder dir nicht gefällt. Du hilfst uns, GymLeader zu verbessern.
Der Link öffnet dein E-Mail-Programm. Falls nichts passiert, kopiere die Adresse und sende eine Nachricht über deinen E-Mail-Dienst.
final: Deine Routine ist der Anfang. Mit jeder Rückkehr baust du darauf auf.
